user.title: Connect to the Freebox
user.description: Home Assistant must be on the same local network as the Freebox. Keep the default address unless you know what you are doing.

data_description.host: mafreebox.freebox.fr works on any Freebox local network.
data_description.verify_ssl: Uses the Free root certificates. Only disable it to troubleshoot.

reauth_confirm.title: Authorize Home Assistant again
reauth_confirm.description: The Freebox no longer accepts the access token of Home Assistant. Submit to request a new authorization, then accept it on the Freebox.

progress.wait_for_authorization: Accept the access request on your Freebox now (front display or as your model asks). You have about 2 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Freebox. Check the address and that Home Assistant is on the Freebox local network.
error.unsupported: This Freebox does not provide the Profile API (Freebox OS API v8 or newer is needed).

abort.authorization_denied: The access request was refused on the Freebox.
abort.authorization_timeout: The access request was not accepted in time. Try again.
abort.authorization_error: The authorization failed, see the logs.
abort.wrong_box: This is not the same Freebox as before.

create_entry.default: Last step: in Freebox OS, open Settings > Access management > Applications, edit "Home Assistant - Freebox Profiles" and enable the "Profiles" permission (parental control). Without it, the integration cannot read the profiles.

init.title: Connection notifications
init.description: Get a notification on your phone each time a device of a profile connects to the Freebox. The phones listed are the ones with the Home Assistant Companion app.

data_description.notify_services: Leave empty to receive no notification. The "Device connected" event entity of each profile is updated anyway.
data_description.notify_profiles: Leave empty to be notified for all profiles.
data_description.offline_delay: A device must have been disconnected for at least this long to count as a new connection, so that a phone waking up from sleep does not notify. 0: notify at every reconnection.

set_override.name: Override profile
set_override.description: Blocks or allows Internet for a profile, ignoring its planning, for a duration or without time limit.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration in minutes. 0 or empty: no time limit.

clear_override.name: Return to planning
clear_override.description: Removes the override: the profile follows its planning again.

missing_permission.title: Freebox Profiles: permission missing
missing_permission.description: Home Assistant cannot read the profiles of {title}. In Freebox OS, open Settings > Access management > Applications, edit "Home Assistant - Freebox Profiles" and enable the "Profiles" permission. This message disappears once it works.

missing_permission.message: The Home Assistant application lacks the "Profiles" permission in Freebox OS.

update_failed.message: Error while talking to the Freebox: {error}
